listing.name: Street Fighter Alpha 3 (Dreamcast) — Street-Alpha-3-Dreamcast-Recomp (irnutsmurt)
listing.summary: The project describes native fighting, online play and controls. Complete character, mode and playthrough coverage have not been established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA NTSC-U Dreamcast release as GDI with tracks 01/02/03, Redump CUE/BIN or CHD. Setup checks the SHA-1 of 1ST_READ.BIN; this guide does not include the expected value.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README’s setup bundle with your own disc. It extracts the files, checks the program, translates the main program and 111 character overlays, and compiles locally. The native setup app creates player shortcuts and VMU data.

warnings: The project describes native fighting, online play and controls. Complete character, mode and playthrough coverage have not been established.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
